bonfire.desc: A big bonfire blazing in a forest clearing at dusk, teenagers in warm jackets standing around it at a safe distance. The photo fills the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

burst.desc: Extreme close-up high-speed photo of a big red balloon popping at the exact moment a pin touches it: the rubber skin tearing apart into ragged shreds, the shape of the balloon still visible as it bursts, plain light background.

final.desc: Close-up of a teenager's hand placing the very last missing piece into an almost finished jigsaw puzzle of a mountain landscape on a wooden table; only one gap left.

enter.desc: A 16-year-old teenage girl filling in an entry form for a competition at a registration desk, pen in hand, other teenagers queueing behind her.

fancy dress costume.desc: A 15-year-old teenager wearing a full green dragon fancy dress costume with a tail and wings, posing at a costume party with balloons and coloured lights, plain wall behind, no signs.
